selection: Preregistered before any round-006 inference and before any round-005 result was exported or analyzed. Round-005 (version 2) stopped when the ChatGPT subscription usage limit turned 856 GPT jobs into retry-exhausted misses. Its Opus pair finished every planned job with valid answers before the limit and is kept. The GPT conditions rerun as round-006 on new prompts whose change order and change dates are both balanced across causes. Decision rules are unchanged from version 2.
decision: Confirmatory claim (effort): the pooled one-sided score test of plain max minus medium no-evidence pass@10, averaged equally over Opus 5.5 (round-005), GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6 Astra (round-006), has p <= 0.05. Each pair is compared within its own round on its own 48 prompts.
Per-model effort results are secondary: each is claimed only if the pooled test passes and its Holm-adjusted one-sided score-test p is <= 0.05. Raw and Holm p are reported together.
The meta-prompt family is exploratory. Its estimates and both tests are reported with raw and Holm p, and no confirmatory claim is made from it.
The distribution test is reported for every pair as a secondary result. A rejection means the conditions behave differently, not that their scores differ.

Every planned job counts; invalid answers are misses. Subscription usage-limit attempts pause the service and are recorded, but do not use up the retry bound. If round-006 does not complete with all 8 conditions, 48 cases and 20 runs per cell, or the round-005 Opus pair is not complete, every test is withheld. An aborted round is published as stopped; this specification is not reused for a rerun.
Round-005 GPT conditions are stopped and reported descriptively only; they enter no test.
Conservative fixed-prompt bounds and scenario sensitivity are reported alongside, as for earlier rounds.
